In detail

This is a low-population, mostly industrial/port-adjacent barri with essentially no tourist foot traffic and no reports of street crime against pedestrians. However, press in May-June 2026 reported a cluster of fatal shootings (organized-crime/narco-trafficking related) in the adjoining Zona Franca/Marina de Port area, and given the barri's industrial character means streets are dark and deserted after dusk, a cautious night rating is warranted even though this violence is targeted (rival trafficking groups), not opportunistic crime against travellers. Sources checked: laciutat.cat, June 2026; metropoliabierta.elespanol.com, 2025.

Barcelona publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is la Marina del Prat Vermell safe?

Wandroz currently rates la Marina del Prat Vermell in Barcelona as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Barcelona during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Barcelona at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Barcelona publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is la Marina del Prat Vermell safe at night?

At night, la Marina del Prat Vermell is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Barcelona. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is la Marina del Prat Vermell a good area to stay in as a tourist?

la Marina del Prat Vermell's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Barcelona) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
